product_metadata.title: mDesign Soft Microfiber Polyester Spa Rugs for Bathroom Vanity, Tub/Shower - Water Absorbent, Machine Washable - Plush Non-Slip Rectangular Accent Rug Mat -Striped Design, Set of 3 Sizes - Mint/Gray
features: ULTRA ABSORBENT: Microfiber absorbs water and dries quickly; The quick-dry fibers keep this rug looking and feeling great, even with repeated use; Floors stay dry, so no more worries about slippery bathroom floors; The extra-long runner-style rug is great for double sink vanities, in front of tubs, in hallways and in entryways; All three rugs are perfect for the guest bathroom, powder room, master baths, kid's bathroom and more; Set of 3

ALL-AROUND COMFORT: The plush cut pile is made of super soft and absorbent microfiber yarns to give you a comfortable and warm place to stand when brushing your teeth or applying makeup; Use in front of bathroom counters, sinks, vanities, showers or bathtubs; Use these beautiful and comfortable rugs throughout the home - try in the kitchen, laundry/utility room, mudroom or entryway

SLIP-RESISTANT: The durable non-slip backing provides long-lasting performance, and it reliably grips the floor keeping the rugs in place, even when wet; Rugs provide a secure place to stand when getting in and out of the shower or tub; Great for kids, teens, adults and seniors; Perfect for houses, apartments, condos, RVs, campers, cabins, college dorm rooms and more

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of 100% microfiber polyester with a long lasting no-skid backing; Easy Care - Machine Washable for easy hassle-free home care; Machine wash separately in cold water; Use mild soap or detergent: Do not bleach or dry clean; Do not wring; For best results line dry
GENEROUSLY SIZED: Extra-long Runner Measures: 60" x 21"; Large Accent Rug Measures: 34" x 21"; Regular Accent Rug Measures: 21" x 17"
